questions.question: In God's message through the prophet Ezekiel, what did Pharaoh, king of Egypt, boast about the Nile river?

answers.text: The Nile is mine and I made it myself
The Nile was handed to me by my gods
The Nile will flow forever just for me

questions.question: Through the prophet Ezekiel, God said Egypt was only a staff made of what to the people of Israel?
God told the prophet Ezekiel that Egypt would one day rise up again and rule over the nations. True or false?
Why did God say He would give the land of Egypt to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon as a reward?

answers.text: Because the labor was done for God
Because Babylon begged God for it
